# RuneBags

> A free tactics board game for two players, played in a web browser. Players
> drop runes into a board of seven columns and six rows; four of a player's
> runes in a line win the round and a point. Between rounds, each player builds
> their own bag of runes in a shop. No account required, no advertising.

Each player draws two runes from their own bag; the opponent never sees them.
On a turn, a player drops one rune into a column, applies its power if it has
one, and draws back up. A line of four wins the round and one point from a
shared pool of 10; the first player to hold the majority of the points
still in play wins the game (6 of 10 at the start; a drawn
round takes a point out of play, so 5 of
9 after one draw). Between rounds, each player may add up to two
runes from a shop offer, remove one, or combine two identical runes into a
level-2 rune. 24 runes have powers; some are cursed or
corrupted, which slips neutral runes into their owner's bag.

It can be played against the computer at five levels, online with a friend by
room code, link or QR code, as rated games matched by Elo rating, by
correspondence (a day for each move, with a notification when it is your
turn), or at the table with a free print-and-play kit. Against the computer a move can be taken
back, and each finished game reviewed move by move, with an accuracy score and
the turning point. Created by Piero Barrette, in Quebec.

## Pages

- [RuneBags — a free runic tactics board game for two](https://runebags.ca/play/): Drop runes into a seven-column board, line up four to win the round, and build a bag of runes that bend the rules. Free, no ads, no account needed: play the computer or a friend online.
- [Rules](https://runebags.ca/rules/): The complete rules of RuneBags: the goal, the shop phase, the round phase, the end of the game, neutral, cursed, corrupted and ethereal runes, and every rune's effect.
- [Beginner's guide](https://runebags.ca/guide/): Your first round, five tips to win more often, the mistakes beginners make, and how the computer's five levels differ.
- [The runes](https://runebags.ca/runes/): Every rune of RuneBags: its power, its level-2 effect, whether it is cursed, corrupted or ethereal, and a diagram of what it does.
- [FAQ](https://runebags.ca/faq/): Is RuneBags free, do you need an account, how to play a friend, how ranked games and the computer's levels work, and more.
- [Print and play](https://runebags.ca/print-and-play/): Play RuneBags at the table: download the free board, quick reference and token labels, and see what you need.
- [The game itself](https://runebags.ca/): the playable application.
